name: Parnesse, the Subtle Brush
oracle_text:
Whenever you or a permanent you control becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter that spell or ability unless that player pays 4 life.
Whenever you copy a spell, up to one target opponent may also copy that spell. They may choose new targets for that copy.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you or a permanent you control becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter that spell or ability unless that player pays 4 life.

needs.what: a becomes_target trigger that fires when a PLAYER ("you") becomes the target of a spell or ability, matching the BECAME_TARGET event's target_player half against the trigger controller, combinable in one trigger with "or a permanent you control" (any permanent the controller controls, not just self) and controller: opponent for whose spell it is, binding sid and event_player so the ward-like may/pay_life/else counter can read them
needs.why_existing_wont_do: becomes_target is matched only against an object subject; stack.announce_targets fires the player-target half with target_player and no oid, and triggers.py never reads target_player, so no trigger can see 'you' being targeted. Ward's rules ability (carddef.ward_ability) is self-only and has no player half; player_hexproof/player_protection are statics, not a pay-or-counter trigger. Writing only the permanent half would silently drop the 'you' clause.
